stem.text: The graph shows the pressure changes in three structures of the **right side** of the heart during the cardiac cycle.

stem.alt: Graph of pressure against time from 0 to 0.8 s, with three pressure traces. The solid line at the top right is labelled T.

stem.text: What is represented by the line labelled T?

A.text: pressure changes in the pulmonary artery

B.text: pressure changes in the right atrium

C.text: pressure changes in the right ventricle

D.text: pressure changes in the vena cava
